procedure.caveat: Public webpage structure only;no complete book procedure,ritual execution or access/closing verification. Link to original text if wanted;no invented substitute prayer.

edition_boundary: 2026 revised book metadata and public author pages are distinct materials. Earlier editions and book/page differences remain uncollated;no full-book coverage claimed.

question_contract.guidance: Frozen explicit-purpose/form mapping selects source references;never infers purpose from question text.
question_contract.answer: Always null;no record retrieval or purported personal source answer.
question_contract.missing: unknown/unspecified purpose stays unspecified;empty/null/missing question preserves reference functionality.
question_contract.reframing: User-selected none/open_reflection/source_research;editorial text never replaces raw question or changes original purpose.

session_contract.ordering: Strict frozen stage order without duplicate IDs or sorting;stages may be omitted and remain unrecorded.
session_contract.completion: Prepared has no completed stages;completed requires explicit completed/skipped finish and no pending recorded stages;discontinued can be empty.
session_contract.source_origin: All application stage tracking is editorial. preparation/finish link opening/closing facts but do not execute or certify a prayer.
session_contract.timestamp: Declared ISO dates/datetimes only;comparable stage clocks nondecreasing;no implicit timezone or timing inference.

input_schema.notes: Unique plain id,optional raw text,kind reflection/association/imagined_scene/unanswered,timestamp,boolean uncertainty and concept_ids;user-attributed only.
input_schema.privacy: All personal content optional;no legal-name,birth,medical,third-party identity or belief requirement. Preserve raw Unicode,whitespace,nulls,omissions and user unknowns.

evidence_matrix.direct: Verified public-page practitioner concepts/structure with original source locators;not verification of extraordinary abilities
evidence_matrix.editorial: Explicit selector mapping,reframes,stage tracking,missing-field observations and neutral reflection prompts
evidence_matrix.unsupported: Metaphysical access,hidden histories,verified past lives,prediction,deceased contact,clinical conclusions or generated retrieved records

supported: Explicit purpose/form reference guidance and optional reframing

replay.serialization: Canonical UTF8 sorted-key compact JSON,unescaped Unicode,no terminal LF;content line endings retained independently of JSON formatting line endings

rights: Original factual paraphrases/structural counts only. No protected prayer,exercises,case histories,site corpus or invented replacement. Link official prayer if wanted;no full-book or downstream reproduction permission claimed.

verification.assurance: Source-backed statements establish practitioner attribution,not metaphysical existence. Synthetic independent workflow fixtures do not validate extraordinary abilities.

reuse: Narrow pure JSON/text/timestamp/freeze/thaw/hash utilities only;prior engines/profiles and all103 prior journal files unchanged.
